description: The Water Supplies Department (WSD) of Hong Kong publishes its operational statistics on DATA.GOV.HK: the total storage of impounding reservoirs every week (million cubic metres, percent full and the same day last year), the storage of individual impounding reservoirs twice a month, the annual number of water main bursts, the annual quantity of fresh water supply and water resources, the price and quality of Dongjiang water imported from Guangdong, drinking, flushing and recycled water quality, and electricity use, renewable generation and emissions of its waterworks. Coverage is the Hong Kong SAR water supply system; the CKAN catalogue lists 24 WSD datasets. Each dataset is a free download as CSV (some also XLSX) with a data dictionary, and is reachable through the DATA.GOV.HK CKAN API, under the DATA.GOV.HK terms, which allow commercial and non-commercial reuse free of charge. Caveats: the burst statistics are only annual territory-wide counts, and there is no network or asset layer (the water mains record plans are a separate, restricted product). Simulation uses: reservoir storage series for drought and supply resilience studies, and burst counts and supply volumes for capacity planning. Related records: the Singapore PUB drain water level sensors (data-singapore-pub-drain-water-level-sensors-flood-alerts).
